notes: Hand-maintained to docs/implementation-plan.md §7.1 until E4 lands and `shogun-mcp --export-tool-table` replaces it (docs/api/tool-table.json.md). §7.1 names 21 tools (18 reads, 2 writes, 1 action); the plan calls the set 'core 22' and E4's freeze in docs/api/core-tools.md settles the final list. Descriptions here are interim; E4-T4 rewrites them for agents and the selection eval judges them.

tools.name: memory.search
tools.title: Search memory
tools.description: Find events and notes in the user's memory by keyword. Free. Not for extracting state: use state.* for people, projects, commitments and open loops.

tools.name: memory.get_context
tools.title: Get current context
tools.description: The user's current work context (focused app, recent events). Free. Prefer memory.get_context_pack for a prompt-ready summary.

tools.name: memory.get_context_pack
tools.title: Get context pack
tools.description: A budgeted summary of the user's current work to put in your own prompt: active people, projects, commitments and open loops with confidence. Free. Call at the start of a task that involves the user's work.

tools.name: memory.get_events
tools.title: Get events
tools.description: Raw events in a time range, newest first. Free. Not for summaries: use memory.get_wrap or memory.get_periods.

tools.name: memory.read_session
tools.title: Read a session
tools.description: The events of one work session (one app, one hour) by id. Free.

tools.name: memory.get_wrap
tools.title: Get day wrap
tools.description: The summary of one day: what happened, what moved, with evidence. Free.

tools.name: memory.get_periods
tools.title: Get period summaries
tools.description: Weekly and monthly summaries over a range. Free. Not for a single day: use memory.get_wrap.

tools.name: memory.recall
tools.title: Recall
tools.description: Ask the memory a question and get the relevant facts within a token budget, each with its source quote and confidence band. Free. Prefer it over memory.search when you need facts rather than events.

tools.name: calendar.upcoming
tools.title: Upcoming calendar
tools.description: The user's upcoming calendar occurrences. Free. Read-only; creating events is an L3 action through actions.execute.

tools.name: profile.whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: The principal this connection serves and the scope it runs under. Free. Call once to confirm the connection.

tools.name: state.commitments.list
tools.title: List commitments
tools.description: Find what the user committed to: promises, deliverables and deadlines made to others, each with the sentence that proves it and a confidence. Free. Not for the user's calendar: use calendar.upcoming.

tools.name: state.open_loops.list
tools.title: List open loops
tools.description: What is pending: questions without an answer, blockers, follow-ups the user is waiting on, each with its quote and confidence. Free.

tools.name: state.people.list
tools.title: List people
tools.description: The people in the user's work, most recently mentioned first. Free. For one person's page use state.people.get.

tools.name: state.projects.list
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: The projects in the user's work with their last activity. Free. For one project's page use state.projects.get.

tools.name: state.people.get
tools.title: Get a person
tools.description: Who this person is to the user and what is pending with them: commitments, open loops, recent evidence. Free. Only people in the principal's own memory.

tools.name: state.projects.get
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: One project: status, people, commitments and open loops that point at it, with evidence. Free.

tools.name: wiki.evidence
tools.title: Evidence for a fact
tools.description: The source excerpts behind a state row or wiki page: quote, event, time. Free. Use it before you report a fact as established.

tools.name: actions.status
tools.title: Action status
tools.description: The state of an action you started with actions.execute: pending approval, approved, sent, refused. Free. Never claim an action happened before this says sent.

tools.name: memory.append_note
tools.title: Append a note
tools.description: Write one durable note into the user's memory (or your scratch namespace). Metered per event ($0.50 per 1,000). L1: local and reversible. Not for transcripts.

tools.name: memory.ingest
tools.title: Ingest events
tools.description: Write the turns or events that changed something so the next agent starts from them; the engine extracts state. Metered per event ($0.50 per 1,000). L1. Set thread_key to your task id and an idempotency_key. Not for storing a conversation verbatim.

tools.name: actions.execute
tools.title: Execute an action
tools.description: Run an action on the user's behalf. L1 runs; L2 (writes to the user's data) returns input_required once; L3 (sending, posting, paying, calendar creation) returns an approval URL a human must open. Metered as a run. Poll actions.status; never report an L3 as done before it says sent.
